title: console: the record page offers the retired sys_comment.reactions column PATCH to a member refused sys_comment_reaction (400 INVALID_FIELD)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cy1y7UNVbT2QAdmgdn

Follow-up of #33343 item 2 (PR #33499), filed on seat 5's instruction. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Gap (measured live on `main` ba35dfd7, showcase boot, stock member)

- The record page picks the reaction **`column` store** when `sys_comment_reaction` reads as absent (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, around line 3179). A member refused that object (no grant, so its definition answers 404) lands there too.
- The column store offers the reaction control under `feedReactionColumn` = update on `sys_comment`, which `member_default` grants.
- Clicking it PATCHes `sys_comment.reactions`, a column retired by migration 18: `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_comment/ID {reactions}` answers **400 INVALID_FIELD** "Unknown field reactions on object sys_comment". (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` answers 403 for the same member.)

## Expected

Offer the column PATCH only where `sys_comment_reaction` is genuinely **undeployed**, never where the caller is merely refused it or the column is retired. Keep the column path itself: the cloud's v17 pin still needs it. A refused caller gets no reaction control (or a read-only one), not a request that is bound to fail.

## Separate decision (not this card)

Whether every member should get read + create on `sys_comment_reaction` (`member_default`) is a maintainer decision now with Elon (#22566 left the shipped set open). This card fixes the console either way.

## Do

1. Pin on `main`: refused member → column store → control offered → 400. CONTROLs: object undeployed → column path still used; grant held → records store.
2. Tell "undeployed" apart from "refused" in the store pick, with no new server signal if the existing meta/grant reads suffice; else stop and report.

Grade p2 (a stock member sees a control that always fails). Clause-②: no expected. Metadata-protocol: none.
